item.title: Re: Different Sectors and site specialty's
item.content:encoded: You can also use the search bar and type in the name of a particular site if the dossier doesn’t tell you enough. That’s what I did when researching Armed Bio-Containment Area-14 for The Drooling Path, and it was very helpful. You can find what other SCPs are contained at a particular place and compare them to yours to get a better feel for where it belongs.

item.title: Re: Different Sectors and site specialty's
item.content:encoded: Secure Facilities Locations is gonna be your best choice here. The creation and curation of a comprehensive list of sites/areas seems infeasible given that nobody’s particularly interested in making sites consistent and we generally don’t get very exclusive looks into what sites specialize at. Sometimes “biological” is all we get.

item.title: Different Sectors and site specialty's
item.content:encoded: I know there’s a list on the scp wiki but to be brutally honest it seems pretty vague to me for instance a bio site could mean a number of things so i was wondering is there a known list of all the different sectors or sites that contain certain types of scp’s for instance zoological sites for megafauna or Humanoid sites for more younger Entity's
